Maria: Quick recap from today's customer workshop. Proposal: small observability pilot — per-route cost card, error fingerprints with trace links, and a safe tracing sampling policy. Pilot: internal + 1 customer (Acme).

Kevin: Agree. Runtime plan: full traces for hot routes, light global sampler. Need feature-flag per-org.

Anya: Ops constraints: async exporters with bounded queues, drop-on-overflow, auto-disable if exporter errors spike.

Phil: Cost sketch: for Acme scenarios (3%/5%/10%) I'll post a worksheet. Retention proposal: 7d full, 30d spans, 90d errors.

Lina: UI MVP: 1) per-route cost (top10), 2) error table w/ fingerprint+trace link, 3) basic sampling policy editor (JSON presets). No deep drilldowns.

Maria: Proposed acceptance criteria: per-route cost card, error analytics MVP, tracing policy UI, canary plan (internal 48h -> Acme 7d), p95 impact <2%. Owners: Kevin(runtime), Anya(ops), Phil(cost), Lina(UI). Deliver runbook + cost numbers by EOD Fri.

Kevin: Will deliver runbook + A/B (top-3 vs top-5) for canary.

OpsBot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary -> org:redwood-internal, start: 2025-06-02T09:00Z, duration: 48h.

Maria: Thanks. I'll draft customer onboarding note and share synthetic data for Phil. Speak up if any objections.
